title: forward
summary: Run a supported dlnetwork forward pass.
description: `forward(net,X)` evaluates a RunMat `dlnetwork` compatibility object over numeric predictor data.
behaviors: Supports sequential feed-forward networks made from `featureInputLayer`, `fullyConnectedLayer`, `reluLayer`, `eluLayer`, `softmaxLayer`, `classificationLayer`, and `regressionLayer`.
Numeric matrix inputs are interpreted as observations in rows and predictors in columns.
`dlarray` inputs are unwrapped for execution, and the output is wrapped back into a `dlarray` preserving the input format metadata.

Name-value execution options, recurrent state outputs, branching DAG execution, automatic differentiation, and training-time behavior are not implemented in this slice and raise explicit compatibility errors.

examples.output: y is a numeric matrix with one row per observation.

gpu_residency: `forward` currently gathers provider-resident `gpuArray` inputs to host before evaluating the supported layer chain. Native Deep Learning provider kernels remain future acceleration work.
